tools.name: get_messages

tools.name: create_export
tools.description: Build a ZIP archive: files and chat history (messages.json + messages.csv) for a period. Built in the background (usually minutes) — get_export returns the status and the link. At most 2 at a time and 10 per day.

tools.name: get_export
tools.description: Export status (queued, running, done, failed, expired), progress and the archive link when ready (the link is valid for 15 minutes — request it again; the archive is kept for 24 hours).

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Account balance in tenge (KZT), the daily charge (330 ₸ per active number) and how many days it will last.

tools.name: get_limits

tools.name: check_number

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Summary: numbers (connected or not) and balance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: send_message, get_messages, get_media, get_limits, set_webhook, get_analytics, list_leads, get_lead, list_links, get_link_stats · Private data: send_message, delete_message, get_messages, get_media, create_export, add_number, set_webhook, get_lead, update_lead, set_number_leads, list_ad_accounts · Public sink: send_message, set_webhook, update_lead, create_link · Destructive: react_message, delete_message, set_webhook, sync_ads.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: send_message, get_messages, get_media, get_limits, set_webhook, get_analytics, list_leads, get_lead, list_links, get_link_stats · Private data: send_message, delete_message, get_messages, get_media, create_export, add_number, set_webhook, get_lead, update_lead, set_number_leads, list_ad_accounts · Public sink: send_message, set_webhook, update_lead, create_link · Destructive: react_message, delete_message, set_webhook, sync_ads

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
